issues: The tape was a 60px grey strip on the left and the readout a small white card; the subject filled under 15% of the frame
The title was debug text (TAPE SCROLL · FIXED POINTER) and the readout card held a grey skeleton bar
The value climbed from 60 to 420 with no story: no reason for the jump, no sense of where it should land
No motion blur in the sprint and tiny (~20px) tape numbers, so the 'world moves, pointer stays' speed was weak
changes: Porcelain look (cool white + cobalt): a full-height tape that fades off top and bottom (minor tick every 10, major every 50 with 64px numbers); a cobalt readout window and pointer notch locked to the centre line, with a 128px white readout

Added a story: a slow crawl presses against the dashed Old limit (140k) line, the upgrade lands and the line splits apart, a small anticipation dip, the sprint, and the cobalt New limit bug parks exactly in the pointer

Curves: swift crawl (slowing against the cap), 22f sprint on bezier(.55,0,.25,1) peaking near 100px/f, spring brake 444→416→420 with one visible rebound; tape and readout get vertical speed blur and the window glow rises with speed
Tape numbers fade out before sliding behind the window instead of peeking out half-cut
Left-side type: a fictional Tideway kicker and a 124px 'Rate limit'; after settling, 'tripled.' rises in cobalt letter by letter, then a ▲200% chip and a mono '140k → 420k' recap
140f → 150f; the value locks to a constant after 110f and the frame drifts 1.0→1.025 at the tail
